key_facts: The team is designing a new remote control that should be original, trendy, and user friendly.
The selling price of the remote control is set at twenty five Euro, with a profit aim of fifty million Euro for the company.
The production cost should not exceed twelve fifty Euro.
The remote control should be multi-functional, capable of controlling household machines such as TV, air-conditioners, and heating systems.
The remote control should be compact and have a friendly shape to improve usability.
The team discussed the idea of the remote control beeping or blinking to help users locate it when it is lost.
The team considered using a light sensor to detect darkness and trigger a signal.
The team agreed that the remote control should have features that justify its price point.
The next meeting is scheduled for thirty minutes from now.
The industrial designer is responsible for the technical-functional design of the remote control.
The marketing person is responsible for creating user requirement specifications, including friendliness and price justification.
